findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: Observed no certified food manager to be available during inspection. Discussed with PIC, PIC will take the steps to receive license. Ensure a certified food manager is available during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: Observed a box of chicken in walk in freezer to be soiled with frozen liquids produced from a walk in freezer leak. Discussed with PIC, chicken box that was damaged was discarded. Ensure foods are stored in a safe, unadulterated section of kitchen.
findings.citation_text: 3-101.11 Safe, Unadulterated, and Honestly Presented. FOOD shall be safe, unADULTERATED, and, as specified under § 3-601.12, honestly presented.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: Observed raw eggs to be stored above vegetables and beef in walk in cooler. Discussed with PIC, education was provided on proper storage order and eggs were moved to bottom shelf in cooler. Ensure storage order is maintained within facility to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(2) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (2) Except when combined as ingredients, separating types of raw animal FOODS from each other such as beef, FISH, lamb, pork, and POULTRY during storage, preparation, holding, and display by: (a) Using separate EQUIPMENT for each type, or (b) Arranging each type of FOOD in EQUIPMENT so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented, and (c) Preparing each type of FOOD at different times or in separate areas.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed sanitizer solution to be testing at 0ppm CL. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer bucket was remade and tested at 100 ppm CL. Ensure a sanitizing solution is mad and available at the proper concentration during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A).

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed date marking to be missing on multiple TCS items in walk in cooler. Discussed with PIC, items will be correctly date marked. Ensure staff is properly date marking any TCS item.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Observed multiple food items in walk in cooler and freezer to not be 6 inches off of ground. Discussed with PIC, items will be moved to at least 6 inches off of ground. Ensure any food item is kept at least 6 inches off of ground to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored.
findings.comment: Observed wet wiping cloths being stored on table in kitchen. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer bucket was prepared and cloths were placed in bucket. Ensure any wiping cloths in use are being stored in a sanitized solution.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.14(B) Wiping Cloths, Use Limitation. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and other EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be: (1) Held between uses in a chemical sanitizer solution at a concentration specified under § 4-501.114; and (2) Laundered daily as specified under 4-802.11(D).

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: Observed a leak to be present at the walk in freezer fan unit. Discussed with PIC, leak will be serviced. Ensure equipment is working up to manufacturers standards.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: Observed significant ice build up at the bottom of walk in freezer. Discussed with PIC, ice will be removed from freezer. Ensure equipment is working and maintained to the manufactures standard. Inspector will follow up on 5/28/26.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed the front of stove unit to be soiled with excessive food debris. Discussed with PIC, surfaces will be cleaned. Ensure staff is cleaning stoves at a frequency that prevents food debris/splash accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: Observed bar triple sink right faucet to leak whenever turned on. Discussed with PIC, faucet will be serviced. Ensure plumbing systems are maintained so no leak is present.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(B) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Garbage and refuse are properly disposed; facilities are maintained.
findings.comment: Observed at least 10 pairs of used gloves to be resting on prep table. Discussed with PIC, education was provided and used gloves were discarded. Ensure after use, gloves are properly discarded after use.
findings.citation_text: 5-502.11 Frequency. REFUSE, recyclables, and returnables shall be removed from the PREMISES at a frequency that will minimize the development of objectionable odors and other conditions that attract or harbor insects and rodents.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: (Repeatx2) Observed caulking to have mold accumulation present at mop sink. Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure facility is monitoring caulking at a frequency that prevents mold accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
